app.tagline: Cook with the season, keep what you love.

login.title: Welcome back.
login.subtitle: Sign in and pick up where you left off in the kitchen.

register.title: Pull up a chair.
register.subtitle: Create your account, then tell us how you like to cook so the suggestions fit.
register.name: Name
register.nameHelper: Optional — what should we call you?
register.passwordHelper: 8+ characters with upper and lower case, a number, and a symbol.
register.passwordTooWeak: Add upper and lower case, a number, and a symbol.

welcome.title: Let's set the table.
welcome.body: A few questions so SeasonPal can suggest dishes that fit your kitchen — not someone else's.
welcome.cuisineBody: The flavours you reach for on a normal week.
welcome.dietBody: Allergies and diets we should always respect.
welcome.timeBody: Tuesday dinner looks different from a Sunday project.
welcome.duration: About a minute, start to finish.

cuisines.title: What do you crave?
cuisines.body: Pick the cuisines you reach for most. Choose as many as you like.

diet.title: Anything off the menu?
diet.body: Allergies, diets, or ingredients you'd rather skip. Pick everything that applies.
diet.interestsBody: Optional — it helps us tune the suggestions.

rhythm.title: How do you like to cook?
rhythm.body: We use this to choose techniques and recipes that feel right for you.
rhythm.timeBody: Leave it unset if it changes day to day.

done.title: Your kitchen is ready.
done.body: Here's what we'll cook with. You can change any of it later.

onboarding.saveError: Could not save your preferences. Try again.

discovery.title: Find your next table.
discovery.subtitle: Search public recipes, then narrow by cuisine, time, meal and diet.

feed.loadError: We couldn't load the public feed.
feed.emptyBody: Try a wider time, another cuisine, or a shorter search.
feed.emptyCommunityTitle: The community table is still being set.
feed.emptyCommunityBody: Publish a recipe and it can appear here for other cooks.

pantry.title: Cook from what you have.
pantry.subtitle: Add the ingredients on your shelf. We'll rank public recipes by how much of each one you already cover.
pantry.body: Match public recipes against your shelf.
pantry.inputHint: Add an ingredient, or a few with commas
pantry.emptyBody: Try fewer or more general ingredients, like "tomato" instead of "cherry tomatoes".
pantry.emptyPromptBody: Add a few ingredients above and we'll find public recipes that need the least extra shopping.

pantry.title: What can I cook right now?
pantry.body: Type what you have. We'll find public recipes that use the most of it.
pantry.empty: Add at least one ingredient first.

rails.forYouTitle: Built from your cuisines and diets.
rails.loadError: We couldn't load the community rails.
rails.emptyTitle: The community table is still being set.
rails.emptyBody: Publish a recipe and it can appear here for other cooks.

taste.loadError: We couldn't load your taste profile.
taste.empty: Your kitchen is open to anything.

library.title: Your recipe library.
library.body: Saved dishes, collections, and your own recipes are ready when you are.

aiCook.title: A sous-chef, soon.
aiCook.body: Ask about substitutions, plan from what is in the pantry, and adapt recipes. Keys stay on the server, never in the app.

profile.title: Your corner.
profile.body: Preferences, published recipes, and account settings will live here. Sign-out and language stay on Home for now.

library.title: My recipes
library.subtitle: What you have written and what you have saved, in one place.
library.emptyOwnBody: Write down a dish you already cook. Photos and steps can come as you go.
library.emptySavedBody: Tap Save on any recipe and it lands here, ready for another night.

detail.aiNote: Made with AI — read it through before you cook.
detail.deleteBody: It leaves your library and any collections. This can't be undone.
detail.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted or kept private.

saveSheet.title: Save to a collection
saveSheet.favoritesBody: Saving always adds the recipe to Favorites.
saveSheet.noCollections: No collections yet. Create one below.
saveSheet.createError: Could not create the collection. Try again.
saveSheet.saveError: Could not save the recipe. Try again.

collections.title: Collections
collections.subtitle: Group recipes for a weeknight, a season, or a table.
collections.emptyBody: Group recipes for a weeknight, a season, or a dinner party.
collections.emptyCollectionBody: Save a recipe to this collection from its page.
collections.removeBody: It stays in your saved library.
collections.removeError: Could not remove the recipe. Try again.
collections.deleteBody: The recipes stay in your library; only the collection goes away.
collections.deleteError: Could not delete the collection. Try again.

editor.newBody: Seven short sections. Save a draft at any point — only the name is required.
editor.editBody: Change what you like. Publication stays as it was unless you publish after saving.
editor.saveError: Could not save the recipe. Try again.
editor.loadError: We couldn't load this recipe for editing.

basics.title: The basics
basics.name: Recipe name
basics.descriptionHint: What it is, and why you make it.

photos.tooMany: A recipe can hold up to 20 photos and videos.
photos.unsupported: Choose a JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP4 or MOV file.

ingredients.title: What goes in
ingredients.name: Ingredient
ingredients.nameRequired: Name every ingredient you fill in.
ingredients.quantityInvalid: Quantities need to be zero or more.

steps.title: How it cooks
steps.instructionRequired: Write every step you fill in.
steps.timerInvalid: Timers need whole minutes between 1 and 1440.

tags.title: A little more detail
tags.body: Tags help you find the recipe later. Dietary tags are shown to anyone who can see it.

publish.label: Publish after saving
publish.body: Published recipes can appear in Discover. You can make it private again at any time.
publish.incomplete: Add at least one ingredient and one step before publishing.
